chunks: Were you present when death came to Jacob, when he said to his sons, 'What will you worship after me?' They said, 'We will worship your God and the God of your fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac, the one God; and to Him we submit.'
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Jacob say to his sons before his death according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate the unbroken chain of monotheism (Tawhid) within the prophetic lineage, emphasizing that the 'one God' worshipped by Jacob's sons was the same God of Abraham, Ishmael, and Isaac. The narrative underscores the concept of *Tawatur* (mass transmission) of faith, where the sons' declaration serves as a historical witness to the continuity of divine worship before the introduction of polytheism. This reinforces the Shia view that true Islam is not a new religion but the restoration of the primordial faith of the patriarchs.
